name: repo_how_it_works_build
description: Generate technical and functional how-it-works guides from repository structure, UML review context, and detected runtime entry points.

inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory for the generated guide bundle. Defaults to Docs/uml/how_it_works.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the repository scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.neighbor_depth: Optional review-context neighbor depth used when context is internally derived. Defaults to 1.
inputs.max_neighbors: Optional limit for retained neighbor modules when context is internally derived. Defaults to 10.

outputs.payload_json: JSON payload that describes the generated technical and functional guide pages.
outputs.guide_markdown_files: Markdown files for the individual how-it-works guides.
